pages.text: Mana Brigade – Innovative games that explore possibilities! Skip to content Home Games About us Contact X Mana Brigade is a FUN-focused game studio striving to create immersive and impactful experiences through user-oriented solutions Our Philosophy “Our goal is to design and create immersive and impactful experiences through user-oriented solutions. With this we hope to push the limits of the game medium with its dynamic complexity.” XR FOCUSED Our team is excited for the future of XR development. We are highly engaged in the latest developments in the technology, and have made several projects in VR. TECHNICAL- AND DESIGN SOLUTIONS We have an adaptable approach to problem solving as we experiment with different technical solutions to get a deeper understanding of the design problem and to be able to present the most optimal solution for any given situation. DESIGN ORIENTED With a background in design, we uphold both structured working procedures through project methodology, as well as making measured design decisions by utilizing an iterative workflow. CUSTOM TOOLS AND ASSETS All our assets are made in-house as we have a broad competence within all fields of production. We also create our own custom-made tools for a streamlined game development process. pages.title: About us – Mana Brigade
pages.text: About us – Mana Brigade Skip to content Home Games About us Contact X Our PhilosoPHy At Mana Brigade, we believe games are more than just entertainment – they’re shared experiences that shape culture, spark connection, and carry responsibility. We design our games with players at the center, striving to create meaningful, memorable, and respectful experiences. We are firmly against exploitative practices and toxic monetization. We believe in fair, honest game design that respects players’ time, intelligence, and investment. Games can be a force for good. That’s the kind of force we want to be.
